node.title: Re^3: Perl script to run for x hours
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [t-rex],

For things under your control (calculations, reading a file), you can implement the timeout yourself (e.g. [marinersk] gave a basic [id://1172790|example]). For network communication, you can usually specify timeouts after which the control will return to your script, at which point you can do your own timeout checks. For external processes, it really depends on the external process. You'll have to be a lot more specific in your question, otherwise the best we can do is general suggestions. [id://510718] and [id://174051]

Regards,
-- Hauke D
